title: EUROLEPORIDS: collaborative science for spatial animal ecology
descr: We are EUROLEPORIDS, an open, collaborative project to study the spatial ecology of Leporids (Hares and Rabbits) across environmental gradients in order to understand how this group of species respond to habitat changes and impact of human activities. We aim to promote comparative theoretical and applied research into rabbit and hare ecology at the European scale. Our open, bottom-up and cooperative structure facilitates engagement of our members and assures that they are involved throughout all stages of the research. Leporids are a vital component of many food webs, both as consumers of vegetation and as important prey for many medium-sized predators. They are also of high cultural importance in many places as game species. The various species and subspecies of European leporids are found across all biomes over the entire European continent. However, many rabbit and hare populations have experienced declines across the European continent in recent times. By compiling data across regions and species we may be able to better answer questions related to their population development, threats, behaviour, habitat selection, and space use.
